                position: l
            })), a
        }, this.delayHide = () => {

            } = this.getProps();

    }

    _adjustPos() {
        let e = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== void 0 ? arguments[0] : "",
            n = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== void 0 ? arguments[1] : !1,
            r = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== void 0 ? arguments[2] : "reverse",
            s = arguments.length > 3 ? arguments[3] : void 0;
        switch (r) {
        case "reverse":
            return this._reversePos(e, n);
        case "expand":
            return this._expandPos(e, s);
        case "reduce":
            return this._reducePos(e);
        default:
            return this._reversePos(e, n)
        }
    }
    _reversePos() {
        let e = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== void 0 ? arguments[0] : "";
        if (arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== void 0 ? arguments[1] : !1) {
            if (Y2.TOP.test(e)) return e.replace("top", "bottom").replace("Top", "Bottom");
            if (Y2.BOTTOM.test(e)) return e.replace("bottom", "top").replace("Bottom", "Top")
        } else {
            if (Y2.LEFT.test(e)) return e.replace("left", "right").replace("Left", "Right");
            if (Y2.RIGHT.test(e)) return e.replace("right", "left").replace("Right", "Left")
        }
        return e
    }
    _expandPos() {
        let e = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== void 0 ? arguments[0] : "",
            n = arguments.length > 1 ? arguments[1] : void 0;
        return e.concat(n)
    }
    _reducePos() {
        let e = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== void 0 ? arguments[0] : "";
        const n = ["Top", "Bottom", "Left", "Right"].find(r => e.endsWith(r));
        return n ? e.replace(n, "") : e
    }
    clearDelayTimer() {
        this._timer && (clearTimeout(this._timer), this._timer = null)
    }
    _generateEvent(e) {
        const n = this._adapter.getEventName(),
            r = {
                [n.keydown]: i => {
                    this._handleTriggerKeydown(i)
                }
            };
        let s = {};
        switch (e) {
        case "focus":
            r[n.focus] = () => {
                this.delayShow()
            }, r[n.blur] = () => {
                this.delayHide()
            }, s = r;
            break;
        case "click":
            r[n.click] = () => {
                this.show()
            }, s = {};
            break;
        case "hover":
            r[n.mouseEnter] = () => {
                this.setCache("isClickToHide", !1), this.delayShow()
            }, r[n.mouseLeave] = () => {
                this.delayHide()
            }, r[n.focus] = () => {
                const {
                    disableFocusListener: i
                } = this.getProps();
                !i && this.delayShow()
            }, r[n.blur] = () => {
                const {
                    disableFocusListener: i
                } = this.getProps();
                !i && this.delayHide()
            }, s = Object.assign({}, r), this.getProp("clickToHide") && (s[n.click] = () => {
                this.setCache("isClickToHide", !0), this.hide()
            }, s[n.mouseEnter] = () => {
                this.getCache("isClickToHide") || this.delayShow()
            });
            break;
        case "custom":
            break;
        case "contextMenu":
            r[n.contextMenu] = i => {
                i.preventDefault(), this.show()
            };
            break
        }
        return {
            triggerEventSet: r,
            portalEventSet: s
        }
    }
    _shouldShow() {
        this.getProp("visible") && this.show()
    }

                if (["leftTop", "rightTop"].includes(e)) return "".concat(-r * 100, "% ").concat(this._roundPixel(n.height / 2), "px");
                if (["leftBottom", "rightBottom"].includes(e)) return "".concat(-r * 100, "% calc(100% - ").concat(this._roundPixel(n.height / 2), "px)")
            }
            return "".concat(-r * 100, "% ").concat(-s * 100, "%")
        }
        return null
    }

    _handleTriggerKeydown(e) {
        const {
            closeOnEsc: n,
            disableArrowKeyDown: r
        } = this.getProps(), s = this._adapter.getContainer(), i = this._adapter.getFocusableElements(s), o = i.length;
        switch (e && e.key) {
        case "Escape":
            Tr(e), n && this._handleEscKeyDown(e);
            break;
        case "ArrowUp":
            !r && o && this._handleTriggerArrowUpKeydown(i, e);
            break;
        case "ArrowDown":
            !r && o && this._handleTriggerArrowDownKeydown(i, e);
            break
        }
    }
    focusTrigger() {
        const {
            trigger: e,
            returnFocusOnClose: n,
            preventScroll: r
        } = this.getProps();
        if (n && e !== "custom") {
            const s = this._adapter.getTriggerNode();
            s && "focus" in s && s.focus({
                preventScroll: r
            })
        }
    }
    _handleEscKeyDown(e) {
        const {
            trigger: n
        } = this.getProps();
        n !== "custom" && (this.focusTrigger(), this.hide()), this._adapter.notifyEscKeydown(e)
    }
    _handleContainerTabKeyDown(e, n) {
        const {
            preventScroll: r
        } = this.getProps(), s = this._adapter.getActiveElement();
        e[e.length - 1] === s && (e[0].focus({
            preventScroll: r
        }), n.preventDefault())
    }
    _handleContainerShiftTabKeyDown(e, n) {
        const {
            preventScroll: r
        } = this.getProps(), s = this._adapter.getActiveElement();
        e[0] === s && (e[e.length - 1].focus({
            preventScroll: r
        }), n.preventDefault())
    }
    _handleTriggerArrowDownKeydown(e, n) {
        const {
            preventScroll: r
        } = this.getProps();
        e[0].focus({
            preventScroll: r
        }), n.preventDefault()
    }
    _handleTriggerArrowUpKeydown(e, n) {
        const {
            preventScroll: r
        } = this.getProps();
        e[e.length - 1].focus({
            preventScroll: r
        }), n.preventDefault()
    }

function Ny(t, e) {

        var n = t > 0 ? "-" : "+";
        return n + lt(Math.abs(t) / 60, 2)

function lQ(t, e, n) {

function cQ(t, e) {

        endColor: r,
        size: s
    } = t, i = n.split(""), o = r.split(""), a = [parseInt("".concat(i[1]).concat(i[2]), 16), parseInt("".concat(o[1]).concat(o[2]), 16)], l = [parseInt("".concat(i[3]).concat(i[4]), 16), parseInt("".concat(o[3]).concat(o[4]), 16)], c = [parseInt("".concat(i[5]).concat(i[6]), 16), parseInt("".concat(o[5]).concat(o[6]), 16)], d = [parseInt("".concat(i[7]).concat(i[8]), 16), parseInt("".concat(o[7]).concat(o[8]), 16)], p = (a[0] - a[1]) / (s + 1), f = (l[0] - l[1]) / (s + 1), g = (c[0] - c[1]) / (s + 1), C = (d[0] - d[1]) / (s + 1);

function Use({
    maxTime: t = 100,
    finished: e = !1
}) {
    const [n, r] = h.useState(0), [s, i] = h.useState(e);
    h.useEffect(() => {
        const a = -Math.log(.01) / t,
            l = Date.now(),
            c = setInterval(() => {
                if (s) {
                    clearInterval(c);
                    return
                }
                const d = (Date.now() - l) / 1e3;
                if (d > t || s) clearInterval(c), r(99);
                else {
                    const p = (1 - Math.exp(-a * d)) * 100;
                    r(p)
                }
            }, 1e3);
        return () => clearInterval(c)
    }, [t, s]);
    const o = () => {
        s || (r(100), i(!0))
    };
    return E.jsx("div", {
        id: "progressBar",
        style: {
            width: "640px",
            height: "20px",
            alignItems: "flex-start",
            padding: "4px",
            overflow: "hidden",
            borderRadius: "10px",
            border: "1px solid var(--Light-usage-border---color-border-1, rgba(29, 28, 35, 0.12))",
            margin: "0 auto"
        },
        onClick: o,
        children: E.jsx("div", {
            style: {
                height: "100%",
                background: "linear-gradient(0deg, #4D53E8, #4D53E8), linear-gradient(90deg, #4752E6 -54.6%, #9F6FF1 160.42%)",
                width: "".concat(n, "%"),
                transition: s ? "width 0.1s linear" : "width 1s linear",
                borderRadius: "10px"
            }
        })
    })
}
